problem_text:
A courier must deliver sensitive documents to eight distinct corporate headquarters.

The travel durations between headquarters are recorded in minutes:
* Alpha to Beta: 43.6 minutes
* Alpha to Gamma: 191.7 minutes
* Alpha to Delta: 59.7 minutes
* Alpha to Epsilon: 157.1 minutes
* Alpha to Zeta: 119.5 minutes
* Alpha to Eta: 129.6 minutes
* Alpha to Theta: 156.0 minutes
* Beta to Gamma: 162.0 minutes
* Beta to Delta: 38.8 minutes
* Beta to Epsilon: 168.3 minutes
* Beta to Zeta: 100.7 minutes
* Beta to Eta: 107.9 minutes
* Beta to Theta: 138.2 minutes
* Gamma to Delta: 132.0 minutes
* Gamma to Epsilon: 164.8 minutes
* Gamma to Zeta: 79.3 minutes
* Gamma to Eta: 67.2 minutes
* Gamma to Theta: 60.6 minutes
* Delta to Epsilon: 134.1 minutes
* Delta to Zeta: 63.3 minutes
* Delta to Eta: 71.8 minutes
* Delta to Theta: 100.8 minutes
* Epsilon to Zeta: 106.9 minutes
* Epsilon to Eta: 114.8 minutes
* Epsilon to Theta: 104.5 minutes
* Zeta to Eta: 12.2 minutes
* Zeta to Theta: 37.6 minutes
* Eta to Theta: 31.6 minutes

The objective is to determine the most time-efficient circuit that commences at one headquarters, visits every other headquarters precisely once, and concludes at the initial point of departure.
